SELECT *
FROM 
    SalesOrder

SELECT *
FROM
    Customer

SELECT *
FROM
    Product

SELECT
    o.SalesOrderID, 
    c.EmailAddress, 
    p.ProductName, 
    o.Quantity
FROM
    SalesOrder AS o
INNER JOIN
    Customer AS c
ON 
    c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId
INNER JOIN
    Product AS p
ON  
    p.ProductId = o.ProductId
